name: x86-TSO
description: A rigorous formal model for x86 multiprocessor memory, validated against AMD and Intel hardware. Captures FIFO store buffers, lock prefixes, and MFENCE barriers precisely.

mca.note: x86-TSO places a single shared memory behind per-thread FIFO store buffers, so a store becomes visible to all other threads at once — multicopy atomic.

catSupport.note: herd7's x86tso.cat is the standard cat rendering; Herding cats proves it equivalent to Sewell et al.'s store-buffer machine, and x86tso-mixed.cat covers mixed-size accesses.

katSupport.note: Covered by kater's kat/tso.kat, which is the same rendering the zoo's by-construction TSO ≡ x86-TSO edge identifies. kat/pex86.kat is the persistency-extended Px86, not this node.
